_comment: Golden-tree description for Layer 5's round-trip (and, per HARNESS-DESIGN.md section 5.2, reusable by Layer 3). Every field here was verified directly against VERSION.json and, where noted, a read-only inspection of the reference install on this machine -- never assumed from RUBRIC.md, which has two confirmed errors recorded below. See TEST-MATRIX.md section 5 'Ground truth constants'.

verified_against.reference_install: /Volumes/Dev/Sites/TSM/hermes (read-only inspection; no single repo is a complete reference -- hermes itself fails D3/D4/D7/D11/D12 per TEST-MATRIX.md)

rubric_corrections.claim: RUBRIC.md section D1 states machineCommands is 9
rubric_corrections.measured: VERSION.json components.commands.machineCommands has exactly 6 entries: setup.md, setup-project.md, update-project.md, update-copilot.md, setup-copilot.md, knowledge-copilot.md
rubric_corrections.note: config.md, reflect.md, skills-approve.md exist on disk in .claude/commands/ but are in NEITHER projectCommands NOR machineCommands in VERSION.json -- they are unmanifested, not merely uncounted.

rubric_corrections.claim: codex plugin tree is '62 files per project'
rubric_corrections.measured: 61 files under plugins/codex-copilot/ + scripts/copilot-gate.sh outside plugins/ = 62 total locked paths, not 62 files inside plugins/ alone.

agents.note: 15 frameworkAgents from VERSION.json plus 'kc', appended only by project_integration.py's _claude_source_files() (line 279) -- NOT by setup-project.md's own bash ROSTER loop, which reads frameworkAgents verbatim and never appends kc on its primary (python3-present) code path.

commands.note: setup-project.md Step 5 copies only protocol+continue; the remaining 5 arrive via update-project.md Step 6.

hook.note: Exists in the framework source (claude-copilot's own .claude/hooks/copilot-hook.sh); no documented setup-project.md/update-project.md step ever copies it (RC-1).

lock.note: RC-4: grep -rl copilot.lock.json over setup-project.md/update-project.md/codex-copilot/scripts returns nothing. No installer path calls the real generator (core/ecosystem/projects.py::write_project_lock).

codex.note: setup-project.md never references plugins/codex-copilot at all. The codex half of a reference install is installed entirely by codex-copilot/scripts/setup-project.sh, a separate installer in a separate repo. /setup-project (claude-copilot) alone can never reproduce the reference install's codex component -- a structural gap distinct from RC-1/RC-2/RC-4.
